info.title: King's Raid: Successors of the Will
info.synopsis: La storia dell’anime sarà totalmente originale, ma quella del videogioco vede lo scudiero Kasel vivere una vita pacifica, il Re Kairu di Orvelia ha ucciso il Re demone Angunmundo 100 anni prima, ma ora i demoni stanno per ritornare. Kasel inizia la sua avventura, con i suoi compagni, per distruggere i demoni e diventare il Guerriero Prescelto dell’Holy Sword Aea.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Kasel, an apprentice knight, spends his days being trained by his best friend, Clause. One day, Demon sightings are reported near the town, and Clause is sent to investigate.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Kasel and Frey reach the King's Forest, and find the corpses of the scouting party that came before them. However, they are unable to find Clause, and are attacked by Demons.

episodes.synopsis: Dominix explains to Kasel and Frey what really happened 100 years ago, when King Kyle fought and seemingly defeated the Dark Lord Angmund. With Demonic activity on the rise, Dominix believes it is time for Kasel to go on a journey of his own.

episodes.synopsis: Kasel and his companions reach the Forest of Elidora, and is greeted by Selene, an elf. She agrees to lead them to their destination, but neither she nor the rest of the forest hide their resentment towards humans.
